newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 10.4 million barrels in the week ended Aug 23 to 318.82 million barrels from 308.43 million in the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.

API said gasoline stocks fell 2.24 million barrels in the week to 196.53 million barrels from a revised 198.77 million barrels that was previously reported as 197.79 million. Distillate stocks fell 463,000 barrels to 105.65 million from 106.12 million.
It said reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.77 million barrels to 37.58 million barrels from 39.34 million barrels in the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units rose to 14.30 million barrels from 14.20 million barrels. Percent of capacity rose to 93.8 percent in the week from 93.0 percent.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week fell to 35.28 million barrels from 35.56 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports fell to 8.38 million barrels per day from 8.78 million, API said.
